run_distributed_gpu_training: run a python training script across multiple GPUs using accelerate launch with multi_gpu flag
launch_deepspeed_training: launch a distributed training job with DeepSpeed ZeRO optimization and multi-node support
launch_tpu_training: launch a training script on Google TPU using torch_xla multiprocessing or TPU pod cluster
launch_fsdp_training: launch a distributed training job with Fully Sharded Data Parallelism for large model training
launch_megatron_training: launch a distributed training job with Megatron-LM tensor and pipeline parallelism
